description: Full register record for one Indonesian law or regulation by type, number and year: title, legal status, state gazette (Lembaran Negara / Tambahan) numbers, dates, the signed PDF, and its relations — which instruments amend or revoke it, which it amends or revokes, related implementing regulations and any judicial-review entry — from the State Secretariat JDIH (jdih.setneg.go.id). Use for "details of UU 6/2023", "what amended PP 5/2021", "get the PDF of Perpres 40/2026".

type.description: Instrument type: UU, PERPU, PP, PERPRES, KEPPRES, INPRES, PERMENSESNEG or KEPMENSESNEG.
